translation_snapshot.source: Old game data for %s correctly installed. You can now play.
translation_snapshot.target: %s 的旧版游戏数据已经安装成功了。你可以现在游玩了。

translation_snapshot.source: It can be used to activate talent: %s (level %d).
translation_snapshot.target: 可以用于激活技能： %s (等级 %d)。

translation_snapshot.source:
#{bold}##GOLD#Shimmer Pack#WHITE##{normal}#: Once purchased the game will automatically install the shimmer pack to your game and enable it for your current character too (you will still need to use the Mirror of Reflection to switch them on).
#LIGHT_GREEN#Bonus perk:#LAST# purchasing any shimmer pack will also give your characters a portable Mirror of Reflection to be able to change your appearance anywhere, anytime!
translation_snapshot.target:
#{bold}##GOLD#时装包#WHITE##{normal}#：购买后游戏会自动安装时装包，同时为当前角色自动开启。仍然需要使用反射之镜来切换。
#LIGHT_GREEN#额外特效:#LAST# 购买任何时装包后，你的角色自动获得便携式反射之镜，可以随时随地切换时装!

translation_snapshot.source: Please use purchased options when not on the worldmap.
translation_snapshot.target: 请不要在世界地图上使用已购买的选项
